SILT#00023: I stumbled across an interesting app called GadgetBridge. It provides a way to link to smartwatches (among other BlueTooth devices) to your Android phone directly and display data from it. I'll be trying it out for my fitness tracker. Link to their homepage: https://gadgetbridge.org
